summary: XR-specific rendering optimizations: Variable Rate Shading and fixed foveated rendering, Instanced Stereo, Mobile Multi-View, forward rendering for VR, GPU profiling shortcut and trimming post-process settings for VR.
gotchas: VRS only on Windows DX12 with VRS Tier 2, Vulkan with VK_KHR_fragment_shading_rate, or Oculus Quest
VRS not compatible with NVIDIA DLSS
Eye-tracked foveated rendering not supported
Instanced Stereo needs engine restart and shader recompile; Mobile Multiview only on modern Mali GPUs

summary: C++ Automation Driver API that simulates keyboard and mouse input against Slate widgets for UI functional tests: locating elements with By::Id/By::Path/By::Cursor/By::Delegate, element actions, sequences and waits, combined with Automation Spec.
gotchas: Synchronous API must not run on the GameThread (deadlocks)
Enabling the driver blocks nearly all real platform input
Path locator has no escape characters
Do not copy non-thread-safe SharedPtrs (Slate) off the GameThread

summary: Explains writing BDD-style C++ automation tests (Specs) with DEFINE_SPEC/BEGIN_DEFINE_SPEC, Describe/It, BeforeEach/AfterEach, async execution, latent completion with a Done delegate, parameterized tests, Redefine and x-prefixed disabling.
gotchas: Implement Define() instead of RunTests()
Spec files suggested as .spec.cpp without 'Test' in the name (guideline only)
Describe blocks run only once at definition time, not during the test
AfterEach recommended only for cleanup

summary: UI guide to the Automation tab in Session Frontend / UnrealFrontend: enabling test plugins, picking a session, toolbar buttons (Start Tests, Run Level Test, Refresh, Find Workers, filters, presets) and exporting results to CSV.
gotchas: Automation tests live in plugins that must be enabled before they appear
Automation tab is empty until a session is selected in the Session Browser
Export only active once reports exist

summary: FBXAutomationTestBuilder plugin for authoring JSON test plans that import/reimport/add LOD to a single FBX and check expected results such as mesh, material, vertex, bone or animation counts.
keys: Window > Automation Tools > FBX Test Builder
gotchas: Requires plugin enable and engine restart
Reimport/Add LOD plans must run after an Import plan that kept its assets
Add LOD needs file names ending _lod00 and matching _lod0X files
Import Options must enable what the expected result checks (e.g. Import Materials)

summary: How to build in-level gameplay tests with a Functional Test actor, scripted from the Level Blueprint or a subclass of AFunctionalTest (PrepareTest, IsReady, OnTestStart, FinishTest), and how to store expected results with Ground Truth Data.
gotchas: Must call FinishTest at the end of the test
Ground Truth Data requires the Functional Test Editor plugin
Level Script references need the actor selected in the editor

summary: Capturing screenshot tests with Functional Screenshot Test / Functional UI Screenshot Test actors or during other functional tests, tuning tolerances, and approving ground-truth images in the Session Frontend Screenshot Comparison browser.
gotchas: Add/Replace/Add As Alternative require a source control connection
First run warns until you approve the ground truth image
Use Delete All Reports before a fresh run; reports accumulate
Screenshots are bucketed by Platform_RHI_ShaderModel

summary: Steps to serve automation HTML test reports from a shared folder with Node.js http-server and Bower, pointing test output there with -ReportExportPath and organizing results into per-session subfolders.
gotchas: Requires Node.js, Bower and Git installed
Localhost cannot be shared; remote access needs proper DNS/IP
Closing the command prompt stops the server

summary: Write editor automation tests as Python scripts (test_*.py in Content/Python) via the PythonAutomationTest plugin, including latent commands with AutomationScheduler, error reporting, expected log errors, screenshots, image comparison and telemetry.
gotchas: Editor does not tick during Python execution; non-blocking calls need latent commands
Screenshots need an extra editor tick, so yield via the scheduler
Expected log error occurrence count must be exact on first call
Plugin must be enabled and editor restarted

summary: Create editor tests as Editor Utility Blueprints derived from EditorUtilityTest (EditorTests plugin), implementing Prepare Test/Start Test and calling Finish Test; test names derive from the asset path.
gotchas: Must call Finish Test or the test times out
If Prepare Test fails or times out, Start Test is not called
Requires the EditorTests plugin and editor restart

summary: Reference for UE C++ assertion macros: check family (halts, stripped in shipping), verify (expression always evaluated), and ensure (non-fatal, reports once to crash reporter), with build-config behavior and examples.
gotchas: check expressions are not evaluated in Shipping, so they must have no side effects; use verify for side effects
Slow variants only run in Debug builds
ensure reports only once per session unless using ensureAlways
Ship with USE_CHECKS_IN_SHIPPING at default 0

summary: How to build and run Catch2-based Low-Level Test executables via Visual Studio Test Explorer, UnrealBuildTool, or the BuildGraph LowLevelTests.xml script, with the test executable command-line reference and the FoundationTests example.
gotchas: BuildGraph is the recommended path and needs generated test metadata files
If Test Explorer shows no tests, Rebuild the test project
Unrecognised arguments before --extra-args go to Catch2

summary: Defines explicit Low-Level Tests (module .Build.cs deriving TestModuleRules plus .Target.cs deriving TestTargetRules), BuildGraph metadata generation, rules reference flags, and engine tests with mocked engine defaults.
gotchas: Explicit is the only test type listed
Metadata .xml files must be writable (check out from source control) before project generation
Engine tests require bUsePlatformFileStub and bMockEngineDefaults since assets need cooking
TestTargetRules disables UObjects, localization, stats by default

summary: Writing Catch2 Low-Level Tests in UE: BDD SCENARIO/GIVEN/WHEN/THEN and TDD TEST_CASE/SECTION structure, REQUIRE vs CHECK, UE test groups with lifecycle events, naming conventions, resource folders and best practices.
gotchas: REQUIRE stops the test on failure; CHECK continues
Other includes go after CoreMinimal.h and TestHarness.h
Test resource files must go in the folder set by SetResourcesFolder

summary: Configure Play In Editor for networked testing: number of players, net mode (Standalone, Listen Server, Client with dedicated server), Run Under One Process, network emulation, client/server options, and per-world Blueprint debugging.
keys: Create Audio Device for Every Player
gotchas: Run Under One Process loads faster but is less representative of real runtime
Number of Players 1 + Play Standalone gives non-networked testing
Breakpoints filter by the selected debug world

summary: Reference for Editor Preferences > Play settings: PIE mouse control, auto-recompile Blueprints, sound, new-window size/position, standalone launch parameters, multiplayer options, Play On Device build/launch configuration and server debug drawing.
gotchas: Play In Editor settings only apply to sessions in the Level Viewport
Window width/height 0 uses desktop resolution

summary: Hub/overview of the Automation Test Framework: test categories (Unit, Feature, Smoke, Content Stress, Screenshot), the testing interfaces (Spec, Driver, Functional, Screenshot, FBX, Blueprint/Python editor tests, CQTest), enabling test plugins and running tests via Window > Test Automation.
gotchas: Smoke tests should finish within 1 second
Test Automation menu appears only after enabling at least one test plugin
Framework depends on engine systems, not ideal for pure unit testing
Tests may run out of order or in parallel; clean up files

summary: Guidance on common CPU/memory pitfalls: garbage collection spikes and manual Collect Garbage, object pooling vs spawn/destroy, Tick vs callbacks/timers/tick intervals, async spreading of work, engine threads, Tasks System, and PSO caching for shader hitches.
gotchas: Garbage collection runs cause processing spikes, especially after destroying many objects
Pooling trades memory for CPU and is less useful for plain C++ structs
Event-driven updates can be worse than Tick if fired many times per frame
Shader compilation causes hitches; use PSO caching/precaching

summary: Console Variables Editor plugin (Window > Console Variables) for viewing, editing, filtering and searching all cvars, saving presets, showing cvar sources, and syncing values in Multi-User sessions.
keys: Add All Changed Console Variables to Current Preset
Project Settings > Plugins > Console Variables Editor
gotchas: Plugin must be enabled
Console commands like stat unit may not appear in suggestions
Only console variables (not commands) can be toggled or auto-tracked
Removing a row resets the cvar to its value at plugin load

summary: Crash report contents and local locations, adding custom game data with FPlatformCrashContext::SetGameData, packaging the Crash Report Client with your game, [CrashReportClient] config variables, where reports are sent, and third-party crash services.
gotchas: Crash Reporter Client is not included in packaged games by default
Epic does not receive reports from packaged builds (as of UE 5.4)
UE ships no crash report server; use your own or Backtrace/BugSplat/Sentry
bAgreeToCrashUpload is only used on Linux

summary: Primer on frame time vs FPS, CPU/GPU/memory bottlenecks, and the profiling and configuration tools available (Unreal Insights, stat commands, RenderDoc, Perfetto, console variables, Output Log, config files, device profiles).
gotchas: Profiling attached slightly worsens performance
Console in packaged builds only in Developer or Debug builds; use Blueprint/C++ to set cvars otherwise
Profile on target hardware; editor preview is not a substitute

summary: Overview hub for the Catch2-based Low-Level Tests framework: explicit test type, testing methodologies (unit, integration, functional, smoke, end-to-end, performance, stress), TDD/BDD, and links to type, write and build/run pages.

Using the SignificanceManager plugin (USignificanceManager) to register objects with custom significance and post-significance functions, update from viewpoint transforms each frame, and scale down behavior of less significant actors.
gotchas: Plugin must be enabled and module added to PublicDependencyModuleNames
Update does not run automatically; call it once per frame
Significance and Concurrent post functions run in parallel and must be thread-safe
The manager itself does not improve performance; you implement the behavior

summary: Table of stat console commands (stat unit, fps, game, gpu, scenerendering, memory, streaming, anim, ai, etc.) with detail on stat levels color codes, stat startfile/stopfile captures, and reading stat unit Frame/Game/Draw/GPU/RHIT times.
gotchas: StartFile keeps running after PIE closes; run stat StopFile to avoid huge .uestats files
Use a non-debug build when reading stat unit for bottlenecks
Visible static mesh elements dominate render thread cost under stat InitViews

summary: C++ stats system reference: declaring stat groups and cycle/counter/accumulator/memory stats, scope cycle counters for profiling your own code, memory pools, GetStatId for tasks, and log-time helpers.
gotchas: Stats used across files need _EXTERN declarations plus DEFINE_STAT in a source file
Memory pool names must start with MCR_
SCOPE_LOG_TIME_FUNC cannot be nested

summary: Overview of Unreal Insights: launching from the editor Trace status bar or prebuilt exe, the Unreal Trace Server and store, loading .utrace files and live sessions, and the Timing, Memory, Networking, Slate, Asset Loading, Cooking and Audio Insights tools.
gotchas: Trace Recorder listens on port 1981
Unreal Trace Server enabled for all desktop platforms as of UE 5.3

summary: Enabling Clang sanitizers (ASan, HWASan, TSan, UBSan, MinUBSan, MSan) in UnrealBuildTool builds for Linux and Android to detect memory, threading and undefined-behavior bugs.

TSan doesn't work on Android; MSan Linux only
HWASan needs NDK 26.1.10909125+; ASan deprecated since Android 14

summary: Gameplay Debugger Tool overlay for runtime AI/gameplay data (Pawn, AIController, Behavior Tree, EQS, perception, navmesh) in PIE, Simulate and standalone; activation keys, the Debug Camera Controller, and C++ extension with custom components and categories.

GameplayDebugger module must be in the project's dependency modules
Extension only possible in C++; Blueprint projects use it as-is
In Simulate, enable the Debug AI show flag

summary: Visual Logger tool for recording and scrubbing per-actor gameplay state: viewport layout, adding actor snapshots via IVisualLoggerDebugSnapshotInterface, logging text with UE_VLOG, and drawing debug shapes with UE_VLOG_* macros.
gotchas: Multiple visual log calls from the same actor in the same frame overwrite earlier snapshot data
Wrap GrabDebugSnapshot code in ENABLE_VISUAL_LOG

summary: Zen Loader, UE5's runtime loader using IoStore .utoc/.ucas containers produced at staging: how to disable it (-SkipIoStore, bUseIoStore=False), limitations, UnrealPak container inspection commands, and LogStreaming troubleshooting flags.

Core redirects and delegate resolvers are ignored during loading; Zen Store is experimental

summary: Enabling the ContextSwitch trace channel and reading the extra CPU core tracks and thread-core lanes it adds in Unreal Insights Timing view.
gotchas: Supported on Windows, XB1/XSX, PS4/PS5 only
